study_design: Prospective register-linked cohort analysis of baseline dietary intake and incident chronic diseases.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The total dietary intakes of 10 054 men and women during the year preceding the baseline examination were determined with a dietary history method.
reason: The abstract identifies incident diseases after baseline and reports a prostate cancer risk estimate for myricetin. No stage, grade, metastasis, lethality, or other aggressive prostate cancer endpoint is analyzed.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Men with higher quercetin intakes had a lower lung cancer incidence (0.42; 0.25, 0.72; P = 0.001), and men with higher myricetin intakes had a lower prostate cancer risk (0.43; 0.22, 0.86; P = 0.002).
estimate_classifications.reason: The myricetin estimate is for general incident prostate cancer risk, with no aggressive endpoint definition.
